root_cause_analysis.symptom: User drags a sidebar candidate onto a Timeline/Kanban slot; events fire correctly and POST /api/save returns 200, but the visible slot card content does not change. Sidebar ✓ also fails to move (because React doesn't re-render the candidate list — the effectiveDay output is identical to before, so the useMemo skips re-evaluation).
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay (scripts/lib/react_template.tpl:1889-1972) only sets card.selected=true when the selected option's name matches an existing PLAN_DATA card's name_base or name_local. It never copies the selected option's content into the card. KanbanView (L843-887) and TimelineView (L1504) read name_base/image/cost/time directly from day.meals[slotId] / day.attractions / day.entertainment — fields that merge() leaves untouched. The data layer is the missing bridge between the editor_selections state map and the rendered DOM. Additional defects: (a) accommodation branch uses Array.isArray on an object (L1915, dead code); (b) no CSS rules exist for the .slot-drop[data-drop-active] / [data-drop-reject] attributes set by the event handlers; (c) the inline 'background: transparent' on slot-drop overlays would override any plain CSS rule by specificity.

root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: The prior cycle's goal was to wire up the bidirectional drag event chain and the save bridge; the merge function was added to surface 'selected' state but its author conflated 'flag the selection' with 'reflect the selection in the rendered data'. Two of the three prior-cycle OUT_OF_SCOPE observations are direct manifestations of the same root cause (cross-meal merge fails because name-match cannot work when the selected option does not exist in the target slot's PLAN_DATA card).

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex returned 12 numbered findings. 2 blockers (Findings 1, 2 — v2-to-PLAN mapping under-specified + activity replacement must prefer timed card and remove duplicates), 5 major (Findings 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10 — meal_alternatives duplicate, deselect ambiguity, source-slot self-write in bridge, inline-style specificity, accommodation Array.isArray dead code, byte-identity AC over-claim, DOM hooks needed), 4 observation_only (Findings 8, 11, 12, plus deselect aspects). All blockers and major findings incorporated into R1/R1a/R1b/R1c/R3/S1/S2 and the AC bodies.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 1 — selOpt-derived content under-specified; v2 options use name/location_summary/cost/time=None/image=None.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a synthesis helper that maps v2->PLAN shape, preserves target-slot time, falls back to existing image, sets name_base/location_base/cost_local, converts/infers display cost.
findings.rationale: Captured verbatim in the Reference Source field-mapping rule and in R1 of the spec; AC1/AC2/AC3 assert visible-text contains the synthesized values.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 2 — Activity replacement must prefer timed card and remove duplicates.
findings.proposed_fix: For each activity slot, find existing card matching ANY option in the slot, prefer the timed card, replace in place preserving the slot time, and remove duplicate selected-option cards from other arrays.
findings.rationale: Captured as R1b in the spec; AC3 asserts time preservation and AC3 last bullet asserts no duplicates.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 3 — Meal alternatives can duplicate after R1 replaces day.meals[dinner].
findings.proposed_fix: After replacing day.meals[slotId], filter the selected option out of day.meal_alternatives[slotId] by option_id.
findings.rationale: Captured as R1a in the spec; AC1 last bullet asserts no duplicate cards bearing the selected option's text.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 4 — Explicit-null (deselect) semantics ambiguous.
findings.proposed_fix: Either exclude deselect from this cycle, or render empty/required placeholder for explicit-null.
findings.rationale: Explicitly deferred to out_of_scope_observations and to Won't Have. R1 only replaces when selectedId is non-null; null cases keep the PLAN_DATA card visible (intentional for THIS cycle).

findings.issue: Codex Finding 5 — Bridge sets editorSelections[originSlotId] = optionId for cross-meal compatible drops; with R1 the source slot will also visibly change.
findings.proposed_fix: Stop setting [originSlotId]: optionId for candidate-to-slot cross-meal selection unless origin equals target; have merge resolve meal option_id across all meal slots.
findings.rationale: Captured as S2 in the spec; out_of_scope_observations records the deeper UX question. AC8 accepts either S2-aligned behavior or the deferred state.

findings.issue: Codex Finding 6 — Inline 'background: transparent' on .slot-drop will beat plain CSS attribute selectors by specificity.
findings.proposed_fix: Remove inline background, OR use !important, OR use outline / box-shadow instead. Use attribute-backed data-drop-success for state.
findings.rationale: Captured as R3 with explicit dev guidance; AC10 accepts any of outline / background / box-shadow as proof, giving dev choice.

findings.rationale: Captured as R1c in the spec; AC9 verifies.

R1c v2 mandates dev seed accommodation-1-2 into data/beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846/days/day-01.json accommodation.options[] with data:image/svg+xml;base64,... cover URI (codex F2 — external URL forbidden due to candidate img onError hide). Selected_option_id stays accommodation-1-1 so AC7 backward-compat holds.

RC-3.concern: R1 says cross-day lookup via editorTripData.days[*].slots[*].options[*] but merge fn signature is only 3-arg
RC-3.resolution: R1 v2 explicitly mandates signature expansion to mergeEditorSelectionsIntoPublishedDay(publishedDay, editorDay, editorSelections, editorTripData), call-site update at L2321-2324, useMemo deps update. findSelectedOption(editorDay, slotId, selectedId, editorTripData) helper with precedence-ordered lookup per codex F3.

RC-4.concern: AC8 had contradictory pass conditions (S2 copies source slot OR leave previous PLAN_DATA visible)
RC-4.resolution: AC8 v2 has single, load-bearing primary pass condition (target slot displays dragged source content). Source-slot post-move state explicitly out-of-scope; deselect-UX deferred.

RC-5.concern: AC11 50ms timing too aggressive for React commit + attribute toggle
RC-5.resolution: Relaxed to 200ms with expect.poll/rAF polling. 600ms removal window kept. Codex F9 also incorporated: success flash MAY land on stable slot card vs only .slot-drop overlay.

RC-6.concern: S1 (data-slot-card/data-slot-id/data-option-id) listed as Should but ACs depend on it
RC-6.resolution: S1 promoted to MUST. Added data-slot-card='primary'|'alternative' distinction per codex F4 to prevent primary/alternative locator collision. Added data-timeline-entry, data-day-cover. ACs use [data-slot-card='primary'][data-slot-id=X] with exact-1 count assertion; no text-content fallback locators.

RC-7.concern: AC1/AC2/AC3 text matching: English names cited but data has name_base (English) + name_local (Chinese); default lang is local
RC-7.resolution: Every AC declares lang='local' precondition. Assertions use Chinese (name_local) substrings. Each text assertion is positive AND negative (e.g. INCLUDES 建新园 AND NOT INCLUDES 云线楼) per codex F5.

RC-8.concern: R2 claims Sidebar ✓ covers Meals+Accommodation+Activity but only AC5/AC6 (Meals) test it
RC-8.resolution: Added AC5b (Activity ✓ via evening_activity-2-1/2-2 swap) and AC5c (Accommodation ✓ via R1c-seeded accommodation-1-1/1-2). Each requires exactly-one ✓ per slot group.

RC-9.concern: AC12 'git diff HEAD~1 HEAD' brittle for multi-commit cycles
RC-9.resolution: AC12 v2 uses 'git diff --stat 9218b6bd..HEAD' (explicit pre-cycle SHA). 'git status --porcelain' clean-tree check added. AC7 backward-compat extended to all 9 Yunnan days (ADV-2).

RC-10.concern: 'byte-identical DOM' phrasing impossible (style+attr additions change DOM tree)
RC-10.resolution: Replaced with: (a) textContent equivalence at [data-slot-card='primary'] locator; (b) per-slot-type card count and ordering; (c) screenshot pixel diff < 1% RMSE. <style> injection and data-* attribute additions explicitly stated as expected and non-violating.

RC-11.resolution: Added R6 + AC13. Timeline entries become drop targets at react_template.tpl:1502-1538 reusing Kanban drop logic with entry._slotId (not entry._type per codex F6).

qa_iteration_v3.qa_verdict: REJECT (narrow) — 11/11 of v1 RCs addressed; 1 new RC-12 (major) from codex adversarial round + 2 advisories

RC-12.concern: v2 ticket internally contradicts itself on cost-field synthesis. Reference Source line 208 ('cost = opt.cost (already in display currency)') is FALSE — v2 option JSON persists raw CNY, _to_display_cost is a Python build-time helper that operates on meals.json PLAN cards, NOT on raw v2 option JSON at React runtime. Dev would have shipped 33 CNY displayed as 33 EUR (~7x misrepresentation). Evidence (lines 106-111) and R1 v2 line 298 correctly identify the issue but the Reference Source mapping rule is the explicit recipe dev would follow.
RC-12.resolution: v3 chose hybrid (a) → (b) alignment with codex-refined precedence. Reference Source 'Dev constraint' (lines 205-215) rewritten: synthesis MUST NOT set numeric cost = opt.cost (raw CNY); instead set cost=0 and emit cost_display = Math.round(opt.cost) + ' ' + opt.currency_local (e.g. '33 CNY') as a string. fmtCost is never invoked on a CNY value. R1 v2 Card-content selection precedence (lines 292-303) rewritten with explicit 3-step ordering: existing active PLAN card match → PLAN alternative match → synthesized v2 fallback — preserving R4 textContent equivalence on the default-render path (Day 1 dinner-1-2 → PLAN alternative card 建新园过桥米线 with cost 4.17 EUR already converted at build time). v3 changelog entry added to QA-Iteration Changelog section.

rejected_alignments.a_alone: Reliable for Day 1 default render (PLAN alternative exists for dinner-1-2) and same-slot meal swaps, but unreliable as the sole strategy for cross-meal injection (AC2: breakfast-2-1 → dinner slot has no PLAN dinner alternative matching breakfast-2-1).
rejected_alignments.b_alone: Works in all synthesis cases but fails R4 — Day 1 default render would synthesize from raw v2 (cost_display='33 CNY') instead of using the PLAN alternative's already-converted 4.17 EUR display, breaking textContent equivalence vs pre-cycle build.
rejected_alignments.c_alone: Rejected per codex OBSERVATION_ONLY: omitting cost loses informative content; sidebar already uses raw-cost-with-CNY-suffix convention at react_template.tpl:1876-1884 — v3 reuses this convention rather than inventing a new omit path.

evidence.meals_json_wrapper: data/beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846/meals.json:1-5 is agent-wrapped ({agent, status, data: {days: [...]}}); top-level .days is absent but .data.days has 9 days populated. Verified by direct Read.
evidence.merge_meals_emit: scripts/lib/render_day_data.py:99-114 emits day.meal_alternatives from data.days[*].dinner.alternatives. Day 1, 2, 7 dinner each have one PLAN alternative.
evidence.plan_alt_cost_already_converted: output/travel-plan-beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846.html:288-305 shows the Day 1 dinner alternative 建新园过桥米线 with cost=4.166666666666667 (display currency EUR) and cost_local=33 (raw CNY) — _to_display_cost ran at build time.
evidence.day_01_default_selection: data/.../days/day-01.json:109 selected_option_id='dinner-1-2' (the alternative); R4 backward-compat requires the rendered card to show 建新园过桥米线 with EUR cost, which IS achievable via the PLAN alternative path (alignment a).
evidence.fmtCost_assumes_display_currency: scripts/lib/react_template.tpl:453-459 fmtCost prepends CURRENCY_SYMBOL (= '€') to its input; passing raw CNY 33 yields '€33' instead of the correct '€4.17'.
evidence.sidebar_already_uses_cny_suffix: scripts/lib/react_template.tpl:1876-1884 adaptV2Option sets cost_display = Math.round(opt.cost) + ' CNY' for sidebar candidates; v3 reuses this exact convention for synthesized fallback cards.

codex_consult_v3.feedback_summary: Codex returned 5 findings (2 OBSERVATION_ONLY + 3 PROPOSED_FIX) on the v3 alignment choice. Codex pushed back on BA's initial 'empty meal_alternatives' premise (which was WRONG — meals.json is agent-wrapped under .data, not .days), and confirmed PLAN alternatives DO exist for Day 1/2/7 dinner. Codex validated hybrid (a) → (b) with refined precedence: existing active PLAN card → PLAN alternative → synthesized v2 fallback. Codex specified the synthesis rule precisely: don't write numeric cost = opt.cost; use cost_display string + cost=0; render paths must prefer cost_display before fmtCost(cost). Codex rejected (c) — sidebar already uses CNY-suffix convention.

findings.issue: BA's initial 'empty meal_alternatives' premise was wrong — meals.json is agent-wrapped, .data.days has 9 days populated, merge_meals emits alternatives.
findings.rationale: Investigation done before v3 edit. v3 changelog explicitly cites Day 1 PLAN alternative as the load-bearing case for alignment (a).

findings.issue: Hybrid (a) → (b) precedence should be: existing active PLAN card match → PLAN alternative match → synthesized v2 fallback. This preserves R4 and prevents default persisted IDs from causing unedited text changes.
findings.proposed_fix: Use the 3-step precedence ordering as written.
findings.rationale: v3 R1 v2 Card-content selection precedence rewritten with codex's exact 3-step ordering.

findings.issue: Synthesis must NOT set numeric cost = opt.cost unless that value is already display currency. For raw v2 CNY, use cost_display = '33 CNY' string label; leave numeric cost = 0.
findings.proposed_fix: Set cost = 0 + cost_display = Math.round(opt.cost) + ' ' + (opt.currency_local || 'CNY').
findings.rationale: v3 Reference Source 'Dev constraint' rewritten with this exact rule, including the gate-on opt.cost > 0 logic and budget aggregation note.

findings.issue: If using (b), Kanban + Timeline render paths must prefer cost_display before fmtCost(cost). Do not put '33 CNY' into cost; fmtCost assumes display currency and numeric comparisons/budget totals expect numeric cost.
findings.proposed_fix: Render paths read cost_display (plain text) when present and opt.cost > 0 is false.
findings.rationale: v3 Reference Source 'Dev constraint' includes the SHOULD for extending Kanban meal/activity/cafe/entertainment and Timeline renders to emit cost_display.

findings.issue: Do not choose (c) — omitting cost avoids misrepresentation but loses useful information; sidebar already displays raw v2 costs with CNY suffix.
findings.rationale: v3 changelog explicitly cites this as the rejection rationale for alignment (c).

codex_consult_v3.feedback_incorporated: All 5 codex v3 findings applied. F2 + F3 + F4 (the PROPOSED_FIX trio) form the core of v3's edits. F1 + F5 (OBSERVATION_ONLY) are cited in the v3 changelog as the empirical grounding for alignment (a)→(b) and the rejection of (c). No findings deferred.

codex_consult_v2.feedback_summary: Codex returned 10 findings. All have PROPOSED_FIX. F1 (lang mismatch) and F7 (CNY vs EUR cost) were the most consequential because v1 ACs would have silently failed or false-passed. F8 (cover is CSS background-image not src) was a verification-method bug. F4 (locator uniqueness) addressed by data-slot-card='primary'|'alternative' distinction. F2 (data: URI for seed) and F6 (entry._slotId not _type) and F9 (flash on stable card) and F10 (AC12 whitelist) are implementation-correctness gates. F3 (precedence-ordered findSelectedOption) and F5 (positive+negative assertions) are best-practice fits.

findings.issue: Lang mismatch — default lang state is 'local' (Chinese), but v1 ACs asserted English substrings ('Zhibushi', 'Mango Tango'); these would fail
findings.proposed_fix: Set UI lang to 'base' before AC1/AC2/AC3, OR assert Chinese substrings
findings.rationale: All ACs (AC1-AC13) declare lang='local' precondition and use Chinese name_local substrings

findings.issue: External synthetic .jpg URL can 404; candidate img has onError hide behavior
findings.proposed_fix: Use stable data:image/... URI or committed/local reachable asset; explicit whitelist day-01.json in AC12
findings.rationale: R1c v2 mandates data:image/svg+xml;base64,... URI; AC12 whitelist added (RC-9)

findings.issue: editorTripData lookup should be precedence-ordered, not a single blind Map<option_id, optionObject>
findings.proposed_fix: findSelectedOption(day, slotId, selectedId) with precedence: target slot → same-day → cross-day fallback; internal map only if preserves arrays + slot metadata
findings.rationale: R1 v2 mandates findSelectedOption helper with precedence-ordered lookup

findings.issue: [data-slot-card][data-slot-id='dinner'] can match primary plus alternatives; collision risk
findings.proposed_fix: Require unique target locator e.g. data-slot-card='primary' or data-slot-role='active'; ACs fail if target count is not exactly 1
findings.rationale: S1 v2 defines data-slot-card='primary'|'alternative'; AC locators require exact-1 count

findings.issue: Positive-only assertions can pass by matching an already-rendered alternative; negative-only can pass on blank/wrong content
findings.proposed_fix: Scoped target textContent must include new canonical substring AND exclude old canonical substring
findings.rationale: All AC text assertions are positive AND negative (e.g. INCLUDES 建新园 AND NOT INCLUDES 云线楼)

findings.issue: Timeline drop should be in this cycle (user explicitly complained 拖到 timeline 没有任何反映); use entry._slotId not entry._type
findings.proposed_fix: Add Timeline drop targets minimally, reusing Kanban drop logic; meals slot id from entry._slotId; activity slot id resolved from editorDay option mapping
findings.rationale: R6 + AC13 added; implementation hint specifies entry._slotId

findings.issue: R1 mapping misses CNY-to-EUR cost issue — v2 option cost is CNY, PLAN cards use display currency (EUR); v2 image often null while PLAN alternatives have images
findings.proposed_fix: Prefer existing PLAN_DATA card matching the selected option/name for image/cost/notes; only synthesize from v2 as fallback; do not display raw CNY as EUR
findings.rationale: Reference Source v2 + R1 v2 mandate PLAN-alternative-card preferred path; v2 synthesis is fallback-only

findings.issue: AC9 cover selector vague — current cover is CSS background-image, not #hero-image/src
findings.proposed_fix: Add stable data-day-cover attribute or require checking computed backgroundImage on known cover element
findings.rationale: S1 v2 adds data-day-cover attribute; AC9 reads getComputedStyle().backgroundImage

findings.issue: Success flash can disappear if tied only to React-replaced .slot-drop overlay
findings.proposed_fix: Set success state synchronously before save and attach measurable flash to stable slot card as well as/instead of .slot-drop
findings.rationale: AC11 v2 + R3 v2 permit flash on slot card in addition to/instead of .slot-drop overlay

findings.issue: AC12 must allow exactly the seeded Yunnan day file if RC-2 uses seeding; otherwise contradicts the new test-data change
findings.rationale: AC12 v2 explicitly whitelists data/beijing-lijiang-dali-20260418-100846/days/day-01.json and optionally accommodation.json
